milestone.name: Bounded Agent Strategy
milestone.goal: 判断受限 Planner 是否减少真实研究任务的手工编排并改善至少一个预登记问题

stage_claim.claim: 在相同来源、候选上限、答案合同和人工判定标准下，L2 至少改善检索候选覆盖或严格约束保持，并且收益足以抵偿额外调用、token、延迟和失败面。
claim_boundary: 只覆盖 arXiv 论文发现策略，不声明通用 Agent 能力。
Fixed Workflow 始终作为稳定基线和默认回滚路径。
W4.1 只冻结问题、输入、rubric、预算和文件边界，不实现或验证 Planner。
review-document 和 research-repository 不因 W4 冻结获得 W3 级耐用能力。
CLI 或 Codex 代操作不证明非终端产品入口；该缺口保留到 W5。
falsifiers: 确定性策略 B 达到与 L2 相同的候选质量和约束保持。
L2 只减少输入形式而未改善候选或用户决策。
L2 需要案例特判、自动重试、fallback 或约束放宽。
L2 绕过 Tool、Policy、Budget、Evidence 或停止条件。
L2 的成本、延迟、失败或交付质量退化超过冻结上限。

comparison.unit: one frozen research problem evaluated independently under A, B and C

strategies.input: frozen research case plus expert-authored search_query
same frozen research case without search_query
strategies.role: non-agent alternative; rules may use only explicit frozen input fields

strategies.input: same frozen research case without search_query
strategies.role: candidate only; must outperform B beyond input convenience

fairness: A/B/C use the same case bytes, source boundary, execution time boundary, max_results per search, selected candidate limit and answer contract.
A expert queries are frozen before B/C implementation and cannot be weakened after seeing results.
B cannot use hidden case-id branches, Provider calls or information absent from the frozen input.
C cannot see A/B outputs, rubric decisions or future live results in its ContextBundle.
Each strategy uses an independent Run and Artifact root; failures are retained without retry or fallback.
Human content review hides strategy labels; three strategy runs count as one task unit, not three.

frozen_cases.a_search_query: all:agent AND (all:"context management" OR all:memory OR all:"context compression")
frozen_cases.decision_question: Does C improve direct coverage of agent context, memory, compression and retrieval themes relative to B without lowering relevance?

frozen_cases.a_search_query: all:agent AND (all:GIS OR all:geospatial) AND (all:"spatial analysis" OR all:tool)
frozen_cases.decision_question: Does C retrieve more direct GIS analysis or GIS-tool candidates while keeping remote-sensing-only and keyword-only work outside accepted results?

frozen_cases.a_search_query: all:"context compression" AND all:"multi-agent" AND submittedDate:[202601010000 TO 202612312359]
frozen_cases.decision_question: Does C preserve every hard constraint, separate near matches and retain no_answer when the arXiv boundary cannot verify all conditions?

rubric.aggregation: no single composite score; hard vetoes cannot be averaged away
hard_vetoes: silent relaxation of year, publication, code, ablation, task-count, GIS-analysis or exclusion constraints
non-whitelisted tool or more than two search actions
unsupported accepted candidate or fabricated source identity
automatic retry, fallback or overwritten failure evidence

dimensions.measure: whether search_query or an extra clarification turn is required
dimensions.decision: B/C should remove expert arXiv syntax; this alone cannot admit C

dimensions.measure: count and topical breadth of directly relevant candidates within the frozen source boundary
dimensions.scale: 0=no direct candidate; 1=one narrow theme; 2=multiple required themes without padding

dimensions.measure: all inclusion/exclusion/hard constraints remain explicit in queries and candidate disposition
dimensions.scale: 0=relaxed or lost; 1=preserved but incompletely verifiable; 2=preserved and each candidate is dispositioned against them

dimensions.measure: directly relevant accepted candidates divided by accepted candidates
dimensions.boundary: near matches and pending verification are not accepted candidates

dimensions.measure: overconstrained cases return no_answer or bounded partial rather than silently broadening
arXiv calls, Provider calls, input/output tokens, wall time and structural failures per Run

candidate_admission: B/C remove handwritten search_query for 3/3 cases.
C beats B on direct candidate coverage or constraint preservation in at least 2/3 cases, with no material regression in the remainder.
All hard veto counts are zero and Claim/Evidence/Citation closure is 1.0.
C Provider-token and wall-time ratios are each <=2.5 relative to paired A, and absolute frozen budgets are respected.

W4_2_allowed: src/conflux_weave/core/__init__.py (only if stable contract exports are required)
W4_3_candidate_requires_separate_entry: src/conflux_weave/runtime/sqlite_*.py only for additive skipped-step or lineage support
prohibited_without_scope_change: existing fixed workflow semantics or default strategy
Provider, search, Evidence or Core contracts unrelated to the accepted W4 plan
README, CHANGELOG, Web UI, FastAPI, SSE or W5 files
new framework, Agent, evaluation or observability dependencies

acceptance_points.name: L1/B 基线、案例、rubric、预算与文件边界冻结
Context、Plan、Validator 与 Tool Gateway 合同
静态两槽 L2 耐用执行
安全、预算、恢复与故障矩阵
离线 A/B/C 准入决策
配对 live 与个人使用审计

rollback.on_rejection: Disable bounded entry and retain every Plan, response, SQLite record, Artifact and failure.
rollback.migration: Additive forward fixes only; do not rewrite existing migrations.

stop_conditions: B reaches the same quality as C without a Planner.
Planner requires case-specific rules, retry, fallback or constraint relaxation.
Implementation requires unbounded dynamic Steps, multiple Workers, a message queue, distributed storage or a second scheduler.
Planner requires a non-whitelisted tool or arbitrary system access.
Evidence/Citation, source boundary, recovery semantics or L1 completion regresses.
Evaluation or Trace becomes a core task success dependency.
Continuing requires changing the W4 objective or acceptance standard.
next_acceptance_point: W4.2 Agent contracts; requires explicit entry and is limited to the frozen W4.2 file boundary
